result.title: Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs
result.summary: Comparing two entities in an image, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) often answer wrongly. We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/describe-dont-decide.

AI.brief_summary: 论文诊断多模态 LLM 在图像实体比较题上的答案偏置：模型自己的实体描述往往已含正确答案，错误却发生在「看着图做决定」时。为此提出免训练 D^3：分别描述两个实体，去掉图像仅凭描述作答，再与直接答案融合，在 8 个 7–9B 模型、10 个基准的 79 个组合上均提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作给出「感知阶段已保留答案、决策阶段被图像干扰」的解耦证据，可供核查 VLM 答案是否真正使用视觉证据，以及推理时分离描述与决策能否缓解信息旁路与视觉证据筛选问题。
